info.title: FCA Universal API
info.description: Access the UK Financial Conduct Authority Financial Services Register to search firms, individuals, funds, and regulated markets, and retrieve register details such as permissions, requirements, addresses, associated individuals, disciplinary history, passports, waivers, exclusions, and fund subfunds.
